title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does When Someone Wrongs Him
caption:
Getting wronged shows you who you really are faster than almost anything. The flesh wants a comeback, a case file, and an audience.

A godly man waits a night. He tells God first. He owns his part, goes to the man directly, and prays for him by name. Then he forgives before the apology comes and leaves the payback where it belongs.

"Never avenge yourselves, but leave it to the wrath of God." Romans 12:19

Save this for the next time someone crosses you.
